gbifID.description: Unique 10-digit numeric identifier for each occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier for the source dataset containing the occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying individual species records.

kingdom.description: The kingdom is consistently recorded as Animalia for all occurrences.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for the recorded species, consistently identified as Chordata.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the recorded species, consistently identified as Aves.

order.description: Taxonomic order classification for the recorded species occurrences.

family.description: Taxonomic family classification for the recorded species occurrences.

genus.description: The genus of the recorded Cinnyris pulchellus specimens.

species.description: The scientific name of the recorded species.

infraspecificEpithet.description: The infraspecific epithet field is entirely empty for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the recorded species, consistently identified as species.

scientificName.description: Scientific names of bird species, including author and year of description.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original scientific name recorded for each species occurrence record.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: The column is entirely empty, containing no recorded authorship information for the scientific names.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for species occurrence records.

locality.description: All values are null, providing no locality information for the occurrence records.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province where the Cinnyris pulchellus occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Cinnyris pulchellus, consistently recorded as present.

individualCount.description: All values are null, indicating no individual count data is recorded for these occurrences.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates ranging from -7.76 to 16.47 degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -17.49 to 40.11.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is not recorded for any occurrence records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is unavailable for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is entirely missing from all records.

depth.description: All values are missing, indicating no depth data is recorded for these occurrences.

depthAccuracy.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data.

eventDate.description: Event date and time of species observation, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

day.description: Day of the month for the species occurrence record, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Month of occurrence, encoded as an integer from 1 to 12.

year.description: Integer year of species occurrence, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifiers for taxonomic classification of Cinnyris pulchellus occurrences.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Cinnyris pulchellus species.

basisOfRecord.description: The basisOfRecord field specifies the method used to document the species observation.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence records.

collectionCode.description: Collection code identifying the source of the observation records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each specimen record in the collection.

recordNumber.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data values.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the Cinnyris pulchellus specimen was identified.

license.description: The license column specifies the Creative Commons usage rights for the occurrence records.

rightsHolder.description: Identifier of the individual or organization holding the rights to the occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded the Cinnyris pulchellus occurrences.

typeStatus.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data values.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of associated occurrence records, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-separated flags indicating data quality issues such as rounded coordinates or missing taxon identifiers.

cinnyris_pulchellus.description: 996 Cinnyris pulchellus occurrence records with taxonomic, spatial, and temporal data from 1986 to 2026.

description: 996 records of Cinnyris pulchellus occurrences spanning 1986 to 2026.
